rules.name: Feedback Creation Timing Constraint
rules.statement: A Feedback Record must only be created after a Delivery Proof exists for the associated Order Request.
rules.condition: When a customer attempts to submit a review for a completed order
rules.if_violated: The submission request is rejected and the customer is prompted to complete delivery first
rules.rationale: Prevents reviews based on incomplete or unverified deliveries, ensuring data integrity

parameters.name: required_delivery_proof_status
parameters.description: Status indicating delivery has been physically verified and proof uploaded

rules.name: Feedback Closure Dependency
rules.statement: A Feedback Record must not be closed if the associated Dispute Ticket is still active.
rules.condition: When a user or agent attempts to close a feedback record
exceptions: Dispute Ticket explicitly marked as resolved prior to closure attempt
rules.if_violated: The closure action is blocked and the user is notified that the dispute must be resolved first
rules.rationale: Ensures unresolved customer grievances are not hidden from the support workflow

parameters.name: active_dispute_status
parameters.description: Boolean flag indicating an open dispute ticket exists for the order

rules.name: Quality Score Impact Rule
rules.statement: A Feedback Record with a negative rating regarding product quality must reduce the overall quality score of the Store Partner.
rules.condition: When a new Feedback Record is submitted for a completed task
exceptions: Feedback explicitly marked as 'not applicable' to quality
rules.if_violated: The quality score calculation is skipped for this record, potentially inflating the partner's score
rules.rationale: Ensures accurate performance tracking and fair compensation for store partners

parameters.name: quality_deduction_factor
parameters.description: Percentage or points deducted from the score per negative quality record

rules.name: Supervisor Routing Threshold
rules.statement: A Feedback Record with a rating below the defined acceptable level must be routed to a Fulfillment Supervisor for investigation.
rules.condition: Immediately after a Feedback Record is successfully submitted
exceptions: Rating falls within the acceptable threshold range
rules.if_violated: The record remains in the general queue, delaying necessary quality intervention
rules.rationale: Ensures low-rated experiences are reviewed by management to prevent recurrence

parameters.name: acceptable_rating_threshold
parameters.description: Minimum rating score required to avoid supervisor escalation
